title: Pune Regional Workshop Venues and Capacity Specifications
text: For corporate customer workshops in Pune accommodating 30 attendees, documented options include Venue A (Kalyani Nagar Conference Hall) and Venue B (Shivaji Nagar Executive Center). Venue A provides a workshop capacity of 30 to 45 delegates in modular U-shape and classroom seating configurations, complete with dual projection systems and interactive audio-visual staging. Venue B supports up to 50 delegates with standard boardroom arrangements.

title: Mumbai Event Venues Overview
text: Corporate facilities in Mumbai include Grand Central BKC and Bandra Executive Suites with capacities ranging from 20 to 100 people. Booking must be completed 14 business days in advance.

title: Cancellation Policy and Refund Terms for Pune Partner Venues
text: Cancellation terms for contracted workshop venues in Pune require written notification at least 5 business days prior to the event date to qualify for an 80% refund of deposit. Cancellations between 48 hours and 5 days incur a 50% cancellation fee, while cancellations within 48 hours are non-refundable. Force majeure claims require division head authorization.

title: Standard Corporate Contracting and General Cancellation Provisions
text: All vendor contracts are subject to enterprise procurement terms. Cancellations made prior to contract finalization incur no penalty. Standard procurement clauses require vendor compliance with ISO 27001.

title: Catering Service Options and Meal Packages for Pune Workshops
text: Pune corporate event packages include tier-1 on-site catering options with morning breakfast, working lunch buffet (vegetarian and non-vegetarian selections), and continuous coffee/tea refreshment stations. External catering partners may be onboarded with a 72-hour food safety certification check. Note that custom dietary accommodations and overnight accommodation packages are not covered under standard catering contracts.

title: IT Equipment & AV Rental Guidelines
text: High-definition projectors, boundary microphones, and dedicated Wi-Fi access points are provisioned by the facilities operations team. Additional requirements for streaming live broadcasts must be requested 48 hours in advance.

title: Transportation and Airport Shuttles for Pune Events
text: Designated cab aggregators provide hourly airport shuttles between Pune International Airport and partner hotels. Requests must be batched by the travel coordinator.
